items.information: Registration cost is $15 online. Registration at the door will not be allowed. Free for UMD students, faculty, staff, and alumni. There is a 200 person competitor limit. Please read the "Competitor Information" tab before registering. ALL SPECTATORS ARE WELCOME TO ATTEND FOR FREE.

items.information: This is the FIRST RUBIK'S CUBE COMPETITION IN MANITOBA! There is a 110 person competiitor Limit on the competition, so please register as soon as you can to ensure a spot. Please read the "Information" tab to understand about the competition and how to register. If you are a new competitor, please look at the "New Competitor" tab for more information on how you might expect the competition to go and run. Also look at the other tabs for more info.

items.name: Zhytomyr Open 2018

venue.details: Main hall is located on the second floor. There is a cafe in the venue where everyone can take a lunch.

items.information: Registration will be closed August, 28 or when we will reach 60 approved competitors. Реєстрацію буде закрито 28 серпня або коли кількість підтверджених учасників досягне 60. Spectators are welcome. There is no entry fee for spectators. Будемо раді бачити вас в якості глядачів. Вхід безкоштовний.
